variants.misreading: Rule 1 of admission only requires effect_source_accepted; effect_seen was dropped from the premise tuple.
Closed-world absence table checks admission_coverage_complete before window_finalized.
Unknown admission_present is routed to the absent (closed-world) arm instead of admission_presence_unknown.
admission_source_accepted is only checked on the matching arm, so unaccepted non-matching candidates get the does-not-establish reason.
The premise helper uses truthiness, so values like 1 or "true" count as holding.
Route table checks effect_observation_accepted before outside_required_pep.
The no-effect credit table omits the required_boundary_refusal_accepted guard.
The refuted helper tests membership in (False,), so the integer 0 counts as refuted.
State comparison uses plain Python ==, so True equals 1 and 1 equals 1.0 regardless of JSON type.
List comparison ignores element order (compares sorted serialisations).
A state key that is present with value null is treated as missing.
Postcondition table checks source_accepted before readback_available.
